title: Robot Density Makes South Korea The Automation Outlier
hook: Counting robots per worker reveals a different automation leader.
closing: Robot density, not installation totals, shows where automation is most concentrated.
question: Would a robot coworker worry you?

segments.say: South Korea has 1,220 industrial robots per ten thousand workers. It leads the density ranking.
The United States has 307 robots per ten thousand workers. South Korea's density is nearly four times higher.
China's robot density is 166 despite leading installations. Total robots and worker-level concentration tell different stories.
